title: Database Query Optimizer
objectives: Optimize database query performance through algorithm improvements
Implement indexing and data structure optimizations
Measure and compare performance using benchmarking
Handle large datasets efficiently with memory management
requirements: Implement optimized version of provided naive query algorithms
Support filtering, sorting, and joining operations on in-memory datasets
Achieve significant performance improvement over naive implementation
Maintain correctness while optimizing for speed
Include benchmarking script to measure performance gains
Handle datasets with up to 100,000 records efficiently
stretchGoals: Implement B-tree or hash indexing for faster lookups
Add support for complex query planning and optimization
Implement memory-efficient streaming for very large datasets
Add query caching with LRU eviction policy
constraints: Work with in-memory data structures (no actual database)
Pure JavaScript implementation without external libraries
Memory usage should scale reasonably with data size
Preserve original query semantics and results
